answer: Each of 141 aliases needs its own inspection logs, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The grove is the wall and the lagoon is the gate: A forklift certification tenure with site inspection logs works as the gate: inspections passed on one site every year. A farm of 141 aliases must climb the wall 141 times, the timber ledger shows every climb, and one honest agent walks through the gate once.
